_readme: Generic queue and send-log model for the detect / queue / send pattern (chapter 04, section 3). Assign it to the module that owns the notifications. Enable data-change capture so the sender can trigger on Create. Adapt the restricted stamp to your access model.
name: NotificationQueue

fields.name: id
fields.note: nq_<dedupeKey>_<minute>; upsert so concurrent events in one minute land on one row

fields.name: status
fields.note: pending | sending | sent | retry | dead | expired | merged | superseded

fields.name: error
fields.note: URLs and sig= already stripped by the post flow

fields.name: card
fields.note: the card spec, already redacted for recipients without access

fields.name: restricted
fields.note: the source record's restricted stamp, so row-level filtering applies to the send log
